title: Wilted Lettuce Salad with Portuguese Sausage
description: A hearty salad made with wilted lettuce, Portuguese sausage, and crispy bacon, perfect for a warm evening.
instructions: 1. In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy.
2. Remove the bacon from the skillet and set aside.
3. Add the Portuguese sausage to the skillet and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
4. Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the red onion to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes.
6. Add the wilted lettuce to the skillet and cook until it's wilted, about 2-3 minutes.
7. Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
8. In a large bowl, combine the cooked sausage mixture, crispy bacon, and red wine vinegar.
9. Drizzle the olive oil over the top and toss to combine.
